sloka: जानामि भरतं क्षान्तं गुरुसत्कारकारिणम् ।सर्वमेवात्र कल्याणं सत्यसन्धे महात्मनि ॥ २.१११.३०॥
transliteration: jānāmi bharataṁ kṣāntaṁ gurusatkārakāriṇam ।sarvamevātra kalyāṇaṁ satyasandhe mahātmani ॥ 2.111.30॥

translations.english: I know Bharata as a man of forbearance and one who honours elders. Everything will turn out well for this great soul wedded to truth.
